svg.aria-label: Drawdown rate by predicted-risk decile. In both the S&P 500 and the S&P 400, the share of stocks that fell 15% or more within 40 trading days rises from the lowest to the highest predicted-risk decile. Dashed lines mark each index's overall rate.
